review.notes: TRIAGE coverage: full-document machine scan of all 32 pages (code-fence balance, structure-inside-fences scan, normalized 4-gram page containment plus word-level missing-token diff against the extracted PDF text), then line-level manual inspection of every low-hit page (1, 11-28) and mid-hit pages 4, 6, 7, 10. Physical p.1 was rendered full-page at 110 dpi and page-bottom footnote bands of physical pages 7, 9, 10, 16, 17, 19 and 23 were rendered at 300 dpi and visually read to transcribe the dropped footnote bodies. Residual low 4-gram hit rates trace to HTML table cell reordering, code blocks with escaped characters, and figure-internal chart/axis text (Figure 5 McEval labels, Figure 6 context ticks 10k-128k, Figures 10-13 legend entries), not droppage; hyphenated line-break splits in the PDF text layer (Cross-CodeLongEval, Cas-sano, preced-ing, high-lighting, up-grade) are correctly joined in the OCR. Footnote URLs 3 and 5 coincide with the plain repo links under the p.1 author block, so word-level scans alone would miss their loss; both were confirmed dropped next to their surviving $^{3}$/$^{5}$ markers.
